#### Celebrating 10 Years of our most popular competition venue!

##### All competitors will receive a commemorative t-shirt included in their registration. Please ensure you list your desired T-Shirt size in your registration comment!

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**
